headline: “The BRSA's new regulation will support payment capacity. It will be renewed in World's 35th year”
summary: Yapı Kredi's deputy general manager said a BRSA regulation applying a lower minimum payment rate to card limits up to 100,000 lira will help consumers pay debts without falling behind. The remarks were made at the World 35th-anniversary meeting.
why: The Banking Regulation and Supervision Agency sets rules for Turkish banks, affecting credit card lending, consumer credit quality and bank earnings.
